en: Welcome to the Laurel Gallery. I keep its records: every team every region has crowned, and the first of each above all.
Read a plinth to see its teams. I've read every one of them myself, more times than I care to count.
Ah, my star! Tickets for next season are selling nicely. The leaders don't know about the matinees yet.
This is the Laurel Circuit's desk. A circuit takes you back to every League you've won, to fight its Elite Four and Champion again in their own rooms.
Back for another circuit? Every one you win raises the next by five levels.
This circuit's teams would all meet you at level {result}. Each League you win again stamps your card when you enter its Hall of Fame.
With every League stamped, the final opens in the Laurel Court: all the Champions you've beaten, one after another.
Then your circuit has begun. Good luck out there, Champion.
Whenever you're ready. The desk will be here.
Your circuit is under way. Stamps so far: {result}. Win each League again and enter its Hall of Fame to stamp it.
Every League is stamped! The final waits for you in the Laurel Court, across the avenue.
